I'll start by reading the test, the broken code, and the data file in this directory so I can fix `broken.js` without touching anything else.The median helper returns only the upper middle value, so even-length arrays fail the reference. I'll average the two middle values and rerun the suite.`node test.js` passes. All 400 cases are ok.

`median` in `broken.js` always returned the upper middle value after sorting. For an even-length array the median is the average of the two middle values, so those cases (190–209) failed. Odd-length arrays still return the single middle value.
thought:
The `median` function in `broken.js` fails for even-length arrays.

The reference implementation returns the average of the two middle elements for even-length arrays. The current code only returns the single middle element.
